# Agent Sandbox Pricing Comparison

> Open, source-linked comparison of AI agent sandbox (code-execution environment) pricing across Northflank, E2B, Daytona, Modal, Vercel Sandbox, Cloudflare Sandbox, Runloop and Sprites (Fly.io). It covers per-vCPU and per-GiB rates, billing models, idle billing, plan fees, concurrency and session limits, and total cost for standard agent workloads. Prices last verified 2026-10-12. Maintained by Northflank.

## Main pages
- [README](README.md): summary tables, workload costs, FAQ
- [Full pricing comparison](comparisons/pricing-comparison.md): rates, CPU-utilisation sensitivity, plans, storage, egress, GPU, isolation
- [Billing models explained](comparisons/billing-models.md): allocated vs active-CPU vs usage billing
- [Hidden costs](comparisons/hidden-costs.md): idle compute, concurrency fees, session limits, storage, egress
- [Methodology](methodology.md): sources, normalisation, formula, limitations

## Scenarios
- [1,000 short-lived sandboxes × 5 min](scenarios/short-lived-agents.md)
- [100 agent sandboxes × 1 hour](scenarios/100-sandboxes.md)
- [1,000 concurrent sandboxes × 2 hours (evals/RL)](scenarios/large-batch.md)
- [10 always-on sandboxes for a month](scenarios/long-running-agents.md)

## Data
- [pricing.json](data/pricing.json): machine-readable rates, plans and scenarios
- [Web estimator](https://p01--sandbox-pricing-estimator--wdgpv6bn4jz8.code.run): price a custom workload (sandbox count, runtime, size, CPU utilisation, concurrency) on every provider
